title: Orsen and the Winter
author: S. M. Voss
blurb: Cyrus Montrose, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
